facts.value: The pool supplies f32 zero and one for generic AttackHi4 motion entry at frame0/rate1/blend0. Existing assembly also uses an f64 unsigned-integer conversion bias while converting the byte stick-tilt timer for comparison with common-data xD0. The input predicates therefore consume more of the pool than just generic entry literals; tuning thresholds themselves remain in common data.
facts.rationale: Capture compiler conversion storage and exact input/initialization order from canonical code and existing assembly; distinguish raw C-stick acceptance from the item-specific usability gate.

facts.value: Accepts A press with left-stick Y>=xCC and tilt timer<xD0, or raw C-stick crossing from previous Y<xCC to current Y>=xCC. The outer C-stick path does not call canUseCstick. With an item present, A together with either held LR or a false item predicate can select LightThrowHi4; alternatively usability-gated C-stick crossing selects it. Item dispatch precedes Ness-specific entry and generic doEnter. Accepted paths return true; only outer input rejection returns false.
facts.rationale: Capture compiler conversion storage and exact input/initialization order from canonical code and existing assembly; distinguish raw C-stick acceptance from the item-specific usability gate.

facts.value: Unconditionally delegates to ft_80084F3C. The helper chooses character ground friction, multiplies it by friction_when_above_walk_speed only when ABS(gr_vel)>walk_max_vel, writes friction acceleration, and prepares ground-normal-aligned animation/self velocity vectors. The owned callback has no local timer, input or state-transition logic.
facts.rationale: Add the missing behavior slot from the exact wrapper and bounded shared physics helpers, without claiming direct position integration.
